tailoring.headline: Lead Developer – eCommerce | SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) | Java, Headless, AI-Assisted
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering enterprise eCommerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, microservices and headless OCC APIs, with proven experience in PIM/ERP/MDM integrations, CI/CD pipelines, AI-assisted development and agile, techno-functional delivery. Strong record of mentoring, code reviews and production support in multinational teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Lead Developer, eCommerce
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Elisa’s vision to evolve its consumer webshop into a modern, composable platform. With 5+ years of hands-on SAP Commerce Cloud development at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in Java-centric, headless eCommerce solutions that align perfectly with your needs.

bullets.label: Leadership & Architecture
bullets.text: Led design and implementation of scalable SAP Commerce Cloud solutions at Rockwell Automation, delivering robust backend services with Java, Spring and OCC APIs, aligning with composable, API-first principles.

bullets.label: Headless & API Development
bullets.text: Built and exposed OCC REST web services and headless APIs for storefronts and third-party integrations, mirroring the Java-centric, headless commerce stack required at Elisa.

bullets.label: DevOps & CI/CD
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) using Jenkins, Docker and Kubernetes, ensuring automated testing and reliable releases.

bullets.label: Mentoring & Code Quality
bullets.text: Conducted code reviews, mentored junior developers and championed test automation with JUnit, fostering high-quality, maintainable codebases.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, holds a valid German residence and work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026 with earliest start 16 December 2026. Open to remote, hybrid or on-site work and looks forward to discussing how I can contribute.

tailoring.why_company: Elisa’s commitment to delivering a seamless, customer-centric digital shopping experience aligns perfectly with my passion for building high-performance, headless eCommerce platforms. I am excited by Elisa’s move toward composable, AI-enhanced commerce and the opportunity to shape the consumer webshop with modern Java-based solutions, while collaborating with a multicultural, agile team that values innovation and continuous improvement.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to drive Elisa’s eCommerce evolution by applying my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to build scalable, AI-enabled, headless solutions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years delivering Java-based headless eCommerce platforms. I’d love to discuss how I can help Elisa scale its webshop. Open to chat!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Lead Developer, eCommerce – Elisa
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Lead Developer, eCommerce position at Elisa. With over five years of experience designing and delivering Java-centric, headless SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am eager to contribute to Elisa’s composable commerce vision. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my technical leadership and AI-assisted development approach can add value to your team.
